TGPSC Manager Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 130 Posts - Complete Details

The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 130 Manager. Candidates with B.Tech/B.E Can Apply Online. The online application opens on 23-09-2026, and closes on 17-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through TGPSC website, tgpsc.gov.in.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
